deviations.what: Home renders no insights and no FAQ section.
deviations.why: Neither exists in the frame. HomeController still passes `posts` and `faqs`; Home.vue accepts them as typed props but does not render them. No controller change made.

deviations.what: Hero headline set with fluid clamp() type rather than fixed 48/64px.
deviations.why: The file ships 1440px frames only. The clamp maximum equals the Figma value exactly at 1440, so desktop is pixel-faithful and only narrower viewports scale down.

deviations.what: Peyda (the family named by every FA type variable) is replaced by Vazirmatn.
deviations.why: Peyda is not licensed for this project; Vazirmatn is the stack the brief specifies. NOTE: public/fonts/vazirmatn ships Regular/Medium/Bold only, but the hero headline is SemiBold (600) — Vazirmatn-SemiBold.woff2 needs adding or the browser will synthesise it.
